divergence: Inherited case pinned the Go-era shape {match, start, end, groups}. docs.jsonata.org String Functions, $match, specifies exactly three fields: 'match - the substring that was matched by the regex', 'index - the offset (starting at zero) within str of this match', 'groups - ... an array of strings representing each captured group', and its worked example $match("ababbabbcc",/a(b+)/) prints index 0/2/5. 'end' has no documentary basis and is derivable as index + $length(match) (jsntrs-eet, decided 2026-08-15).
